gloss: tea drinker; teetotaler; person who doesn't drink alcohol

definitions.gloss: tea drinker; teetotaler; person who doesn't drink alcohol
definitions.explanation: A person who prefers tea or other non-alcoholic beverages over alcohol. An older, somewhat playful expression contrasting with {左党|さとう} (a drinker). Derives from the traditional association of the right hand with rice (and by extension, non-alcoholic drinks).

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右党|うとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧⟦{飲|の}まない→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: My father is a teetotaler and doesn't drink alcohol at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右党|うとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This drinking party has a menu that non-drinkers can enjoy too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{左党|さとう}→左党：23468_satou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{右党|うとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: My friend who drinks and I who don't enjoy drinking parties in different ways.

notes:
The origin of this term relates to traditional Japanese customs. In the drinking culture, the ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ (left) side was associated with sake (because craftsmen held their chisel in the left hand and their hammer — ⟦{槌|つち}→槌：29978_tsuchi⟧, homophonous with a sake vessel — in the right), so ⟦{左党|さとう}→左党：23468_satou⟧ came to mean a drinker. {右党|うとう} is its counterpart for non-drinkers.

This is an older expression that is still understood but less commonly used in modern casual conversation, where ⟦{下戸|げこ}→下戸：19823_geko⟧ (non-drinker) is more typical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右党|うとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a non-drinker
- {右党|うとう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{左党|さとう}→左党：23468_satou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: both drinkers and non-drinkers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{左党|さとう}→左党：23468_satou⟧: drinker, sake lover — the opposite term for someone who enjoys alcohol
- ⟦{下戸|げこ}→下戸：19823_geko⟧: non-drinker — the more common word for someone who can't or doesn't drink
- {上戸|じょうご}: heavy drinker — someone who can drink a lot
